name: Scene Subtree Mover
changes: Add move (Pro), Save named order (Pro) and Preview saved order (Pro) can now be selected without Pro. They show how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button. The preview and the saved orders do not change.
tip: Select Manuscript root in Destination parent to promote a nested scene.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Scene Subtree Mover is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with your writing.
